entities.description: Registration procedure initiated after PLMN selection for mobility and periodic updates.

entities.description: De-registration performed locally by the UE without network signaling.

entities.name: Initial registration for emergency services
entities.description: Initial registration initiated for emergency services when selected cell cannot provide normal service.

entities.name: New PLMN selected
entities.description: Condition where a new PLMN is selected by the UE.

entities.name: New SNPN selected
entities.description: Condition where a new SNPN is selected by the UE.

entities.name: Selected cell cannot provide normal service
entities.description: Condition where the selected cell in the new PLMN is known not to provide normal service.

relations.description: PLMN selection may result in a new PLMN being selected.
SNPN selection may result in a new SNPN being selected.
When a new PLMN is selected, the UE resets the registration attempt counter.
When a new PLMN is selected, the UE initiates registration for mobility and periodic registration update.
When a new SNPN is selected, the UE resets the registration attempt counter.
When a new SNPN is selected, the UE may perform local de-registration.
When a new SNPN is selected, the UE initiates initial registration.
If the selected cell cannot provide normal service, the UE may perform local de-registration.
If the selected cell cannot provide normal service, the UE initiates initial registration for emergency services.
